item.text: Inspecting the reconstructed JSON for the incorporation jurisdiction and IRS Employer Identification Number, then I’ll return the shortest document-supported answer in the required format.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json, re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/ADOBE_2016_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
for i,el in enumerate(data.get('texts', [])):
    t=el.get('text','')
    if re.search(r'incorporat|Employer Identification Number|EIN|IRS Employer|Delaware|California|Employer Identification', t, re.I):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',el.get('page_no'))
        print(t[:1000].replace('\\n',' '))
        print('---')
PY"
